purpose: Represent time-dependent degradation, cascading effects and dependencies between transport and other infrastructure layers.
unlock_rule: Disabled until a documented transition law and interdependency edges are provided; static observations alone cannot identify a cascade mechanism.

primary_sources.citation: Cats and Jenelius (2014), Dynamic vulnerability analysis of public transport networks, Networks and Spatial Economics.
Ouyang (2014), Review on modeling and simulation of interdependent critical infrastructure systems, Reliability Engineering & System Safety.

known_limitations: Static correlation is not a causal dependency.
Dynamic assignment or an external simulator may be required.
